celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ﴾ is wrapped up and its light taken away,

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ﴾ swoop down and fall onto the earth,

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ﴾ are taken away from the face of the earth and become scattered dust,

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ﴾ pregnant she-camels ﴿عُطِّلَتْ﴾ are left without a herdsman, or without milking, because of the calamity that has struck them, though no property was more pleasing to them than they,

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ﴾ are gathered after the resurrection so that retaliation may be taken for some of them against others; then they become dust,

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ﴾ without doubling and with doubling [سُجِرَتْ], are kindled and become fire,

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ﴾ are joined to their bodies,

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ﴾ the girl buried alive for fear of shame and want ﴿سُئِلَتْ﴾ to reproach her killer,

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ﴾ it has been read with kasra on the tāʾ, as a reporting of what she is addressed with; and her answer is to say: "I was killed without any sin."

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ﴾ the scrolls of deeds ﴿نُشِرَتْ﴾ without doubling and with doubling, are opened and spread out,

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ﴾ is stripped from its places as the skin is stripped from a sheep,

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ﴾ the Fire ﴿سُعِّرَتْ﴾ without doubling and with doubling [سُعِرَتْ], is set ablaze,

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ﴾ is brought near to its people so that they may enter it — the answer (jawāb) of إِذَا at the beginning of the sura and of what is conjoined to it is:

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ﴾ i.e. every soul, at the time of these things mentioned, which is the Day of Resurrection, ﴿مَا أَحْضَرَتْ﴾ of good and evil.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ﴾ they are the five stars: Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury. They takhnusu, with ḍamma on the nūn, i.e. go back along their course, behind them: while we see the star at the end of a zodiacal sign, it turns back towards its beginning; and they takinsu, with kasra on the nūn, enter their lairs (kināsihā), i.e. disappear in the places where they disappear.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ﴾ advances with its darkness, or retreats,

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ﴾ extends until it becomes clear daylight,

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ i.e. the Quran ﴿لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ﴾ honoured by Allah the Exalted, and he is Gabriel; it is attributed to him because he brought it down,

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿ذِي قُوَّةٍ﴾ i.e. of mighty powers, ﴿عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ﴾ i.e. Allah the Exalted, ﴿مَكِينٍ﴾ of high standing; عِنْدَ is attached (mutaʿalliq) to it;

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ﴾ i.e. the angels in the heavens obey him, ﴿أَمِينٍ﴾ over the revelation.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ﴾ Muhammad ﷺ — conjoined to إِنَّهُ to the end of what is sworn upon — ﴿بِمَجْنُونٍ﴾ as you claimed.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ﴾ Muhammad ﷺ saw Gabriel in the form in which he was created ﴿بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ﴾ the clear [horizon], which is the highest, in the direction of the east.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿وَمَا هُوَ﴾ Muhammad ﷺ, ﴿عَلَى الْغَيْبِ﴾ what is hidden of revelation and news of the heaven, ﴿بِظَنِينٍ﴾ suspected; in one reading [بِضَنِينٍ] with ḍād, i.e. miserly, so that he would hold back any of it.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَمَا هُوَ﴾ i.e. the Quran ﴿بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ﴾ who eavesdrops ﴿رَجِيمٍ﴾ stoned.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ﴾ by what path do you go in your denial of the Quran and your turning away from it?

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ not ﴿هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ﴾ an admonition ﴿لِلْعَالَمِينَ﴾ mankind and jinn,

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ﴾ a badal (substitute) for الْعَالَمِينَ, with the preposition repeated, ﴿أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ﴾ by following the truth.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ﴾ uprightness upon the truth ﴿إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ the creatures, your uprightness upon it.
